description: This file defines a custom authentication success handler for Spring Security. It updates user's last access timestamp upon successful login and redirects to the admin home page.

classes.name: UserAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: Custom handler extending Spring Security's success handler to update user login info and redirect after login.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Handles post-authentication logic: updates user's last access time and redirects to admin homepage.
